AttributePath.Name: Actor Attribute
AttributePath.Hint: The actor value used to pick a tier. For dnd5e, this is the challenge rating at system.details.cr.

SelectionFormula.Name: Selection Roll
SelectionFormula.Hint: The roll made to pick a row within a tier. Each row covers a range of results from this roll.

ActorTypes.Name: Actor Types
ActorTypes.Hint: The types of actors that can receive currency, separated by semi-colons. For dnd5e, this is npc. Leave it blank to allow every type.

TypePaths.Name: Creature Type Attributes
TypePaths.Hint: The actor values compared against the Creature Types setting, separated by semi-colons. Leave it blank to skip the creature type check.

TreasureConfig.UnknownPathWarning: Actors do not appear to have this value. It can still be saved: some values exist without being listed.
TreasureConfig.CurrenciesHint: The currencies that generated treasure is added to. Each one needs a name and the actor value it is stored at.
TreasureConfig.NoTiers: There are no tiers yet. Add a tier to start generating currency.
TreasureConfig.ResetContent: Replace the entire treasure table with the defaults for this game system? Nothing is saved until you press Save Changes.

Errors.CurrencyBlank: Each currency needs a name and an actor value.
Errors.InvalidFormula: "{formula}" is not a valid roll formula.
Errors.InvalidRange: Each row needs a roll range with the start no higher than the end.
Errors.InvalidTierRange: Each tier needs a lowest value no higher than its highest value.

TreasureMenu.Name: Treasure Table
TreasureMenu.Label: Configure Treasure Table
TreasureMenu.Hint: Set up which actor value picks a treasure tier, the rolls that are made, and the currencies that are filled in.

Enabled.Name: Enabled
Enabled.Hint: If enabled, currency will be generated for tokens dropped in scenes.

ShowChatMessage.Name: Show Chat Message
ShowChatMessage.Hint: If enabled, a chat message will be created any time currency is generated.

CreatureTypes.Name: Creature Types
CreatureTypes.Hint: These are the types of creatures that will generate currency, separated via semi-colons. They are compared against the creature type attributes set in the treasure table menu. Leave it blank to generate currency for all types of creatures. Example: Humanoid;Aberration;Monstrosity

ChanceOfNoCurrency.Name: Chance of No Currency
ChanceOfNoCurrency.Hint: This is the percent chance that no money will be generated for a token.
